name: Saeki Mao
source:
Like Yuuki, she is a nurse at the university hospital.
She has a cheerful personality and can quickly get along with anyone. She adores her senior nurse, Yuuki.
She looks younger than her actual age, but she seems to be concerned about being seen as childish.
She tends to be seen as a bandwagoner, but she has a strong core.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080916134727/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/mao.html]official website,archived[/url]]
